hook: He was trapped inside a grounded sailboat.
narration: A man was trapped inside a sailboat that ran aground near Coronado, California.
This is the helicopter's infrared camera. It sees heat, so warm bodies glow against the cold water.
The rescue swimmer from Air Station Ventura got down to the wreck. [short pause] To reach the man, he tore open part of the cabin roof.
outcome: The Ventura aircrew got the trapped man out of the wrecked sailboat.
title: Trapped inside a wrecked sailboat
description:
A man was trapped aboard a sailboat that ran aground near Coronado, California, on Oct. 11, 2026. A Coast Guard Air Station Ventura aircrew rescued him after the rescue swimmer tore open part of the cabin roof to reach him.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard courtesy video, Air Station Ventura, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1026132
